[F#5]mission, third World War, third round A

close like a casket, on truth devour-

spectacle monopolized The
cameras eyes on choice disguised Was it

hold the reins, stole your eyes All the
Fistagons, the bullets, and bombs Who
stuff the banks, who staff the party ranks

None of the above. Fuck it, cut the cord!
